sources.observation: A white arched bay, oval window, narrow louvres and a metal ramp identify the stone visitor frontage.
A north arrow and metric scale establish the approximate layout of the three levels, named rooms and connecting passages.
Broad rock-carved caps, recessed trilithons and inward corbel bands frame the middle-level chamber.

limitations: The underground shapes and stair connections interpret a historical drawing and photographs. Horizontal registration beneath the visitor building is approximate.
The geographic model preserves street terrain and neighboring foundations. Chamber views use fixed review cameras. The viewer’s normal walk mode follows the ground surface.
